summary: The 9-8-8 Implementation Act of 2026 aims to improve the implementation of the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline and expand behavioral health crisis response services across the United States. It provides funding and structural changes for call centers, mobile crisis response teams, and crisis stabilization facilities, while updating coverage requirements for public and private health insurance programs.

affected_groups.effect: Will have expanded access to crisis call centers, mobile teams, and stabilization facilities, with broader insurance coverage for these services.
affected_groups.group: Individuals experiencing mental health or substance use crises

affected_groups.effect: Will benefit from expanded workforce training programs, minority fellowships, and grant funding for hiring and operations.
affected_groups.group: Behavioral health and crisis response workers

affected_groups.effect: Must comply with new requirements to provide benefits for crisis response services with financial requirements and treatment limitations no more restrictive than general medical benefits.

key_provisions: Establishes a regional and local lifeline call center grant program authorized at $441,000,000 for fiscal year 2027.
Increases authorizations for the Mental Health Crisis Response Partnership Pilot Program to $100,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2029.
Creates a national suicide prevention media campaign under the Secretary of Health and Human Services.
Provides $1,000,000,000 in authorization for health center capital grants to alter, renovate, or construct crisis response facilities.
Mandates coverage of crisis response services under Medicare, Medicaid, CHIP, TRICARE, the Federal Employees Health Benefits program, group health plans, and for veterans.
Establishes a panel to issue recommendations and data collection standards for 9-1-1 and 9-8-8 dispatchers regarding behavioral health crises.
Revises the Medicaid Institution for Mental Diseases (IMD) exclusion to allow federal matching for certain certified community behavioral health clinics and crisis facilities.
missing_information: Exact long-term budget impact beyond the specified authorizations.
Detailed criteria for state-by-state allocation formulas of grant funds.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The 9-8-8 Implementation Act of 2026 aims to improve the implementation of the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline and expand behavioral health crisis response services across the United States. It provides funding and structural changes for call centers, mobile crisis response teams, and crisis stabilization facilities, while updating coverage requirements for public and private health insurance programs.
summary_detail.significance: The bill represents a sweeping federal effort to standardize and fund the mental health crisis response infrastructure surrounding the 9-8-8 system. By coupling grants for facilities and workforce training with mandatory insurance coverage and integration with 9-1-1, the legislation aims to substantially shift how emergency behavioral health services are delivered nationwide.
